verdicts.note: 主語Iが歩く能動。Walking in が正。
Feeling tired(状態の現在分詞)。
Opening the door(能動)。
付帯状況 reading a book。
Hearing the news(能動)。
否定はnotを分詞の前に。Not knowing。
by everyoneより受動。Praised が正。
岩は見られる側=受動。Seen が正。

verdicts.multiple_valid_note: 'Finishing the work, she went home.' も文法的に成立する(連続動作)。ただし完了の前後関係を示す Having finished が分詞構文単元の意図。
verdicts.note: Having finished(完了分詞構文)が最適。
否定はnotを前に。Not being tired。
主語Itを残す独立分詞構文 It being sunny。
Being ill(理由の分詞構文)。
慣用的独立分詞構文 Generally speaking。
書き終えてから鞄へ=完了 Having written が自然。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Walking down the street, I found the shop.
verdicts.note: walkingは文頭で大文字化。Walking down the street の分詞構文。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Not saying anything, he left the room.
verdicts.note: 否定分詞構文。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Having finished my homework, I watched TV.
verdicts.note: 完了分詞構文。havingは文頭で大文字化。

verdicts.multiple_valid_note: トークン 'Smiling,'(大文字S+コンマ固定)は文頭専用。小文字sheは文頭に置けないため 'She looked at me, smiling.' はトークン形を崩さずには作れず、唯一解。
verdicts.note: 付帯状況の分詞構文 look at me。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Written in English, this book is easy to read.
verdicts.note: 受動(過去分詞)の分詞構文。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Seeing the dog, I ran away.
verdicts.note: When I saw → Seeing。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Being tired, she took a rest.
verdicts.note: Being省略しない指定。

verdicts.produced_sentence: When he saw the police officer, he ran away.
verdicts.note: Seeing → When he saw。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Having eaten lunch, I went out.
verdicts.note: After I had eaten → 完了分詞 Having eaten。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
verdicts.note: As he did not know → Not knowing。

verdicts.produced_sentence: Being written in easy English, the book sold well.
verdicts.note: 受動分詞構文・Being省略しない指定。
